generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Ultium full-size pickup (Silverado EV twin). 2024: Denali Edition 1 only, about 205 kWh 800 V-capable pack (later named Max Range). 2025 added Extended Range; 2026 added Standard Range (400 V, about 220 kW DC peak per reports), Elevation and AT4 trims, and 11.5 vs 19.2 kW onboard charger options. These are packs on one platform, so powertrains, not generations. EPA base model "Sierra" is safe because the EPA import is BEV-only. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://news.gm.com/home.detail.html/Pages/news/us/en/2025/mar/0327-2026-gmc-sierra-ev.html ; https://www.cargurus.com/Cars/articles/2026-gmc-sierra-ev-pricing-specs-release-date
